pr_title: [regexp] Simdify global atom match with single character pattern
pr_description: Use Highway SIMD to count matches for single-character RegExp atom patterns and track the last match position. Accumulate newly counted matches into the existing total so searches resumed after a cache hit preserve cached matches.

ground_truth.reason: This PR includes the feature with the fix already applied, so the vulnerability is not present

agent_reasoning: The SIMD implementation counted matches locally but overwrote the in-out number_of_matches parameter, discarding matches restored from the cache. Changing the final store to += preserves that cached count while adding new matches. This single-line source edit exactly matches the supplied fix commit's runtime-regexp.cc; no test files were changed, and workspace validation passed.
